name: a4a
description: A YouTrack-style issue tracker with a REST API, an MCP server and Claude-powered AI features

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @a4a/web build && pnpm --filter @a4a/server build && pnpm --filter a4a-mcp build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @a4a/web check:design && pnpm --filter @a4a/web check:words && pnpm --filter @a4a/server test && pnpm --filter a4a-vscode test
